description: Animate a chess move: set up starting position, then animate the white pawn moving from e2 to e4.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board

DEFAULT_FEN = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"

class ChessBoardMoveAnimated(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        board = Board()
        board.set_board_from_FEN(DEFAULT_FEN)
        self.add(board)
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(board.move_piece('e2', 'e4', instant=False))
        self.wait(0.3)
